  ᚱᚢᚾᛖ rune · your runes, deployed
  {VERSION} ({COMMIT}) built {TIME}

  Flow:
    setup       [--defaults]                                          Guided first-run configuration
    init        <SLUG_OR_DIR> [--lang] [--purpose] | --module <DIR>   Scaffold a project from a skeleton, or a deck module
    target      [SLUG_OR_PATH|-] [--list]                             Bind or show the working repository
    add         <ID[,ID...]>                                          Add runes to the consumer manifest
    skill       add <NAME[,NAME...]> | install | show                 List or stage skills; ship the rune agent skill
    agent       [add <NAME[,NAME...]>]                                List or stage agents by name
    rule        [add <NAME[,NAME...]>]                                List or stage rules by name
    hook        [add <NAME[,NAME...]>]                                List or stage hooks by name
    context     [--json]                                              Agent-ready brief of the working context
    tui         [--source <DIR>] [--edit]                             Launch the terminal dashboard
    dashboard   [--source <DIR>] [--port <PORT>]                      Launch the read-only web dashboard
    install     [--source <DIR>] [--target <DIR>]                     Assemble and deploy rune content
    review      list | export [--target <DIR>]                        Inspect or export TUI review comments

  Spec:
    spec        propose | list | show | doctor | archive | context    Spec-driven change lifecycle under docs/

  Deck:
    status      [--source <DIR>]                                      Show deck, spec, change, and deploy status
    doctor      [--target <DIR>] [--verify] [--repair]                Check and repair deployment integrity
    validate    [--source <DIR>]                                      Validate deck or rune files against schemas
    drift       [--source <DIR>] [--upstream <DIR> | --target <DIR>]  Compare source, build, and deployment drift
    provenance  [--target <DIR_OR_FILE>]                              Show deployed-file provenance
    clean       [--source <DIR>] [--target <DIR>]                     Remove stale installed files
    release     [DOMAIN] [--source <DIR>]                             Package rune release tarballs
    import      <URL> [--module <DIR>]                                Import an upstream rune with provenance
    provider    [enable|disable <name>]                               List or toggle deploy providers
    todo        [add|do|ls|obsidian]                                  Repo tasks in TODO.txt with an Obsidian transform
    watch       <COMMAND>                                             Manage monitored rune locations

  Plumbing:
    assemble    [--source <DIR>]                                      Assemble rune content into build/
    deploy      [--source <DIR>] [--target <DIR>]                     Deploy assembled runes
    copy        --source <DIR> --target <DIR>                         Copy runes without transforms
    config      [set <KEY> <VALUE>]                                   Resolved configuration (deck, targets, lore, artifacts)
    find        <QUERY>                                               Find local runes by relevance
    exec        <SKILL> [-- ARGS...]                                  Run a script bundled with a skill
    launch      <TOOL> [-- ARGS...]                                   Launch a coding tool with middleware
    completion  install [SHELL] | print <SHELL>                       Shell completions (bash|zsh|fish|nushell)

  Quick start:
    rune init N4M3Z/demo --lang rust --purpose tool
    rune target N4M3Z/demo
    rune add development
    rune tui --edit
    rune install

  rune <command> --help for flags and details
